author: blu
body: Proves tap and sacrifice activated abilities. A "{T}: ~ deals 1 damage" pinger compiles to an ActivatedAbility with a tap cost; the AI taps it in the main phase and pings the opponent's biggest creature. A "Sacrifice ~: ~ deals 2 damage" ability compiles with a sacrifice cost; the AI fires it only when the damage trades up (kills the opponent's biggest creature), routing the sacrifice through destroy-permanent so the source goes to the graveyard.
